test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 28 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the fourth number is related to the third number.

7 : 42 :: 5 : 20 :: 11 : ?
solution:
The Logic followed here is:-

**[First term × (First term - 1)] = Second term**

In 7 : 42

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f23373eea7c0444cd3a20fe0f660e06b382eb89d2804cfc1394ae8e5f053561.png] 

In 5 : 20

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a3135fdafdced2a22848c4f12f06d327a75f21a62b3c5d47c07513b825954ca.png] 

Similarly, In 11 : 110

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dca578ae814fe91461e93ccd395c80792d73b097116825ce83cee86a404d29b3.png] 

Thus, it can be clearly seen that 110 is related to 11.

Hence, the correct answer is **"110".**
